subject: Coordinating a SOC 2 / DPA / Pen-test walkthrough — availability?
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-corp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 13:34:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — aligning calendars

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the engineering/security team at Acme want to do a short walkthrough focused on SOC 2 scope, our outstanding DPA redlines, and a high-level pen-test timeline. We usually try to keep these syncs to 45 minutes.

Are you and/or someone from your security/product team available for a 45-minute slot next week (we're looking at Dec 7–9)? Timezone note: most of our security folks are Eastern (US).

What we'd like to cover:
- SOC 2 controls scope and audit cadence
- Where logs/audit trails live and retention
- Pen-test cadence and whether red-team engagement is supported
- DPA redline walkthrough and next steps for counterparty review

If you can share 2–3 slots that work for your team, we’ll pull in the right folks on our side. I can also send an initial checklist if useful.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Sr. Security Program Manager | Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

--
Attachment: initial_request.txt (text stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — aligning calendars

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to coordinate. I’ve looped in Markus (Head of Security Ops) to cover SOC 2 and pen-test logistics. Stephanie from Legal will join for the DPA redline discussion if that's OK.

Proposed 45-min windows (all ET):
- Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 ET
- Wed Dec 8, 14:00–14:45 ET
- Thu Dec 9, 11:30–12:15 ET

If none of those work, tell us two times that do and we’ll adjust. I’ve attached the SOC2 checklist and our latest DPA redlines to give your team a head start.

I’ll prepare notes and a short attack-surface slide for the pen-test portion.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (212) 555-0142

--
Attachments: SOC2-checklist.pdf, DPA-redlines.docx

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-corp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — aligning calendars

Thanks Naomi — all three options look promising. Our security lead (Paula Ramos) is only available in the morning on Dec 8. Can we lock the first slot: Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 ET?

One request: can you include a short section (5–7 min) on data residency and log access procedures — we need to show that to our audit team. Also please send a calendar invite & preferred dial-in.

I’ll distribute the SOC2 checklist internally once we confirm.

Regards,
Jordan

On a separate note, do you have preferred redline fields we should prioritize? (e.g., data deletion windows, subprocessor list)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — aligning calendars

Jordan — locking Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 ET. Sending invite now (attached).

Agenda (30–45 min):
1) Quick intros (5 min)
2) SOC 2 scope + audit cadence (Markus) — 10 min
3) Data residency, log access, retention (Naomi) — 7 min
4) Pen-test approach & timelines (Markus) — 7 min
5) DPA redlines: key asks and next steps (Stephanie) — 10 min
6) Action items & owners (5 min)

Stephanie — FYI on the redlines: Jordan asked about deletion windows and subprocessor disclosures. Can you flag the two clauses we expect to negotiate?

Jordan — attachments included: SOC2 checklist (PDF), our current DPA redlines (DOCX), and a calendar .ics for the confirmed slot. If you prefer a Teams link instead of Zoom let us know.

Thanks — Naomi

--
Attachments: calendar-invite.ics, SOC2-checklist.pdf, DPA-redlines.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — aligning calendars

Hi all — quick note from my side: I’ll focus SOC 2 discussion on scope (in-scope services vs. platform-level controls) and our continuous monitoring approach. For pen-test, we typically run an annual engagement and can support customer-initiated tests on a case-by-case basis; I’ll outline the gating process.

Jordan — if your team has a standard pen-test questionnaire, please drop it into the HubSpot thread linked below and we’ll prep answers ahead of the call to speed things up.

HubSpot thread: https://hubspot.com/contacts/ACME-2345

See you on Wednesday.

-Markus
